title: Interactive Distribution Inputs for Shiny
text: lightweight Shiny input wrapper around modist: draggable probability distributions behave like regular Shiny inputs. shinymodist keeps default presentation compact low-noise, retaining opt-style = "modist" mode close upstream experience.

title: Interactive Distribution Inputs for Shiny
text: input returns distribution family canonical parameters: fixed visible scale can supplied comparisons need common domain: Server-side updates use update_modist_input().
code: library(shiny) library(shinymodist)  ui <- fluidPage(   modist_input(     "dist",     family = "normal",     value = list(mu = 0, sigma = 1)   ),   verbatimTextOutput("value") )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   output$value <- renderPrint(input$dist) }  shinyApp(ui, server) list(   family = "normal",   mu = 0,   sigma = 1 ) modist_input(   "scores",   family = "normal",   value = list(mu = 1, sigma = 1),   domain = c(-5, 5) )

title: Interactive distribution input — modist_input
text: input_id Shiny input id. family Distribution family supported bundled modist version. value Named list initial distribution parameters. Missing parameters use family defaults. domain Optional numeric vector length two giving fixed visible domain. style Visual preset: "minimal" "modist". ticks Optional logical. NULL inherits selected style. grid Optional logical. NULL inherits selected style.
